name: Westfield Santa Anita
description: Westfield Santa Anita is a premier enclosed regional shopping destination in Arcadia, California, featuring over 200 stores and restaurants including major department store anchors like Macy's, Nordstrom, and JCPenney. This expansive retail center combines high-end fashion brands with popular retailers, dining options, and entertainment venues including a state-of-the-art AMC theater. Located in the heart of the San Gabriel Valley, it serves as the primary shopping hub for the affluent communities of Arcadia, Pasadena, and surrounding areas.
demographics: Affluent suburban families in the San Gabriel Valley area with significant Asian-American population and high household incomes
summary: A flagship Westfield regional mall in the San Gabriel Valley featuring 200+ stores, upscale dining, and major department store anchors serving affluent suburban communities.
